thesis: Read the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's own SOFR series: while its 20-session change is negative, own duration at the 10x gross cap; while it is positive, sit in the shortest bill available. The switch is one official observation, so a reader can reproduce every decision.
drivers: Best trade: 10-Year 91282CNT4 (long, secondary-curve to secondary-curve) 2025-10-15 to 2025-10-20 for $3,735.64.
Worst trade: 10-Year 91282CNT4 (secondary-curve to margin-liquidation) 2025-11-04 to 2026-05-19 for $-34,181.69.
8 of 20 closed trades made money; coupons paid $0.00 and financing cost $-26,293.12.

Official par curve over the window: 3-month 4.02% -> 4.14% (+12 bp), 2-year 3.52% -> 4.74% (+122 bp), 10-year 4.06% -> 5.01% (+95 bp), 30-year 4.66% -> 5.35% (+69 bp). Duration exposures are paid off against this path.
The venue liquidated the account 1 time(s) under its declared maintenance rule; those fills are in the tape with the reason recorded on each one.
